items.title: Diagnose Before You Refine: Multi-Dimensional Judge Feedback for Query-Efficient Jailbreak Attacks
items.one_liner: JSB is an automated LLM jailbreak framework using multi-dimensional judge feedback to achieve high success rates with minimal queries.
items.summary: The paper presents Jev-Guided Strategy Bandit (JSB), a query-efficient automated jailbreak framework for large language models that utilizes multi-dimensional probabilistic feedback. JSB combines continuous jailbreak scoring with targeted refinement, strategy switching, and best-state reseeding to optimize adversarial prompts. items.title: MontageFlow: Physically Valid High Fidelity EEG Generation
items.one_liner: MontageFlow generates physically valid clinical EEG data by enforcing multichannel linear voltage identities, improving TS-FID.
items.summary: MontageFlow is a flow-matching generative model designed to produce high-fidelity, physically valid clinical electroencephalography (EEG) data. The authors show that standard generators violate exact linear identities governing multichannel EEG voltage differences. MontageFlow resolves this by restricting outputs to valid signals meeting these identities and conditioning the model on a physiological state vector. Across three large-scale benchmarks, MontageFlow improves TS-FID by 1.6 to 3.6 times compared to existing models while ensuring physiological validity.
items.bottom_line: Generative models for clinical EEG must enforce multichannel linear voltage identities to ensure physical validity and improve generation fidelity.

claims.text: We therefore propose MontageFlow, a flow-matching model that enforces these identities by restricting its output to signals that satisfy them.
